content.title: Reject a non-numeric funding amount without changing balance or transaction history
content.intent: Prove that a funding attempt with a non-numeric amount is rejected and does not create a false balance change or a completed transaction record.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning for an invalid non-numeric monetary input and negative/error technique because the PRD requires monetary inputs to obey numeric rules and failed financial operations to avoid false committed state. Web-form and auth-gated profiles applied. Risk-gated interaction strength was 3 because money, auth, and data-loss apply; the effective coverage stayed at a single representative invalid partition because only one outcome-changing input family is under test here. Budget: no ceiling set, so this scenario was kept.
